# The addresses a commit's author, committer or Co-Authored-By trailer may carry (issue #663). GitHub
# credits the account an address belongs to with every commit whose trailer names it, and a squash merge
# copies a pull request's trailers onto main, so a trailer that carries an address must carry one the
# project owns or uses.
#
# Read by test/lint (TestBranchCoAuthorTrailers, coauthortrailer_rule_test.go), which checks the branch's
# own commits against this list, their author and committer addresses too (a squash merge credits every
# distinct author of a pull request's commits); a trailer with no address at all, such as
# "Co-Authored-By: pi (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash)", needs no entry. One address per line, compared in any
# letter case, no angle brackets; # starts a comment line. See the Commits section of
# .claude/skills/go-tdd/SKILL.md.
#
# Never add noreply@pi.dev, noreply@deepseek.com, noreply@earendil-works.com or pi@earendil-works.com:
# they belong to third-party accounts, which the tester's old trailers credited.

# Claude Code's commits.
noreply@anthropic.com

# GitHub itself: the committer of every commit made through its API or web interface, such as the
# release App's and Renovate's commits on their pull request branches and every squash merge on main.
